parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese (default)
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: QueryKey
parameters.description:
The key of the global configuration. Valid values:

*   **soar_filed_tags**: queries the input template of the playbook.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar describe-field --query-key soar_filed_tags --lang zh --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sophonsoar DescribeField --region cn-hangzhou --QueryKey soar_filed_tags --Lang zh
